mods.description: Route Zotero HTTP and document loading hooks through the Ztractor host adapter.

notes: Replaced upstream not-implemented HTTP hooks with calls into Zotero.__ztractorHost.

mods.description: Route Zotero repository lookups through the Ztractor translator registry when present.

notes: Added a host registry path while preserving Zotero's upstream HTTP repository fallback.

mods.description: Replace upstream Node-only jsdom parsing branches with host-provided DOMParser.

notes: Removed jsdom requires from Node parsing paths so the browser runtime bundle stays dependency-free.

mods.description: Make upstream XRegExp browser bundle safe inside the generated ESM runtime.

notes: Renamed Browserify-local require identifiers so downstream bundlers do not resolve internal XRegExp modules.
Replaced the CommonJS XRegExp fallback with the bundled global runtime value.
